addons.name: Hello from my fork
addons.description: A sample add-on from a personal repository: says hello and counts how often it was opened.
addons.about: The sample add-on of the repository template: a page next to Home (press its button or number), a service part that answers /api/addons/forkhello/hit and keeps a counter in its own settings. Copy this folder, rename the id, change the page.
